note: Empty by design. Historical cases must be selected and locked before post-event outcomes or retrospective explanatory articles are reviewed. Every future source must include explicit human or institutional authors and a publisher, plus stance, affected claims, timing, reliability and archive reference. Contradictory and mixed evidence must be cited in the case-level contradiction review. Any NotebookLM, Gemini or other AI-assisted research must be disclosed separately from evidence and verified against the original registered sources.
